subject: math
topicName: Trigonometry: Choosing Law of Sines or Law of Cosines
description: Choose the Law of Sines or the Law of Cosines for oblique triangle problems by reading the given information before solving.
learningObjectives: Classify triangle information as AAS, ASA, SSA, SAS, or SSS
Select the Law of Sines for AAS, ASA, and SSA cases when an opposite angle-side pair is available
Select the Law of Cosines for SAS and SSS cases when no opposite angle-side pair is available at first
Identify cases where either law may be useful after a first missing part is found
Annotate a mixed triangle problem with the given case, first move, and reason for the chosen law
prerequisites: AAS, ASA, SSA, SAS, and SSS triangle cases
